title: Maradona's 'Hand of God' ball sells for £2.5m
summary: The football used in Diego Maradona's 'Hand of God' goal during the 1986 World Cup quarter-final against England has sold at auction for £2.5 million. The iconic artifact represents one of football's most famous and controversial moments.
content: The football with which Diego Maradona scored his famous 'hand of God' goal in the 1986 World Cup quarter-final victory over England is sold at auction.

zh.title: 马拉多纳"上帝之手"球以250万英镑成交
zh.summary: 迭戈·马拉多纳在1986年世界杯四分之一决赛中对阵英格兰队时进球所用的足球在拍卖会上以250万英镑的价格成交。这件标志性的文物代表了足球历史上最著名和最具争议的时刻之一。

title: Why are Australians thriving in WSL but not Premier League?
summary: Australian footballers once dominated England's Premier League, but now only one player remains in the competition. The WSL, by contrast, continues to feature strong Australian talent, highlighting a significant shift in where the country's players compete.
content: The Premier League used to feature a host of top Australians. Now there is just one player from the country in the competition, but it's a very different story in the WSL.

zh.title: 为什么澳大利亚人在女超而非英超中表现突出？
zh.summary: 澳大利亚足球运动员曾经主宰英超联赛，但现在只有一名球员留在这项赛事中。相比之下，女超联赛继续拥有强大的澳大利亚球员阵容，突显了该国球员竞争地点的重大转变。

title: Celtic intensity pursuit of Torino's Gineitis - gossip
summary: Celtic has intensified its pursuit of Torino midfielder Gineitis as part of squad strengthening efforts. The club has instructed players to stay off social media during the transfer window.
content: Celtic step up midfielder chase as squad told to stay off social media.

zh.title: 凯尔特人加紧追逐都灵的吉涅蒂斯 - 传闻
zh.summary: 凯尔特人队加紧了对都灵中场球员吉涅蒂斯的追逐，作为球队加强的一部分。俱乐部已指示球员在转会窗口期间不要使用社交媒体。

title: Quiz: Do you know these footballers from their haircuts?
summary: A new BBC Football quiz challenges fans to identify footballers based on their distinctive hairstyles. Featured players include Erling Haaland, who recently cut his long blonde hair before the new Premier League season.
content: Erling Haaland shaved off his flowing blond locks before the new Premier League season - but do you recognise these other footballers from their haircuts?
